name: manual_478474
claim: orama-system TDD gate (pre-commit check for adjacent *.test.ts(x) when web/src/ production files change) fires on merge resolution commits even when no new code was authored. Override with 'tdd-skip: <reason>' in the git commit message body — the commit-msg hook reads this line and bypasses the TDD requirement.

decisions.notes: Blocked merge-conflict-resolution commit on orama during PR #113 merge; tdd-skip: is the canonical escape hatch, not --no-verify

rationale: Blocked merge-conflict-resolution commit on orama during PR #113 merge; tdd-skip: is the canonical escape hatch, not --no-verify
